title: Washroom cleanliness को consistently score कैसे करें
excerpt: Consistent washroom scoring fixed observable criteria, clear rating definitions, same scale, calibrated inspectors और cleaning failures को maintenance defects से अलग रखने पर depend करती है।
content_html:
Washroom score तभी useful है जब same condition को देखने वाले inspectors similar result तक पहुँचें। “Looks good” जैसे impressions की बजाय observable criteria define करें।

Criteria पहले define करें

Fixture soil, high-touch condition, floors, supplies, waste, odour source, moisture, mirrors, grout/scale और maintenance faults जैसी items use करें।

One simple scale use करें

एक example: 2 = meets standard, 1 = minor defect, 0 = fails standard। Pass/fail system भी work कर सकता है। Important clear definitions हैं।

हर rating define करें

Floor “meets” = clean, dry, no visible soil/residue/slip risk. Minor defect = small correctable area. Fail = widespread soil, standing water या safety issue। Definitions checklist में लिखें।

Cleaning और maintenance failures अलग रखें

Blocked toilet, leaking tap या failed exhaust को cleaning score में hide न करें। Maintenance exception separately record करें।

Weighting only when justified

Standing water, missing soap या heavily soiled touchpoint minor mirror streak से ज्यादा operational importance रख सकते हैं। Weighted scoring हो तो rules पहले document करें।

Inspectors calibrate करें

Supervisors/inspectors same washroom score करके results compare करें। Differences vague criteria reveal करती हैं।

Scores trends के लिए use करें

Single score से ज्यादा repeated pattern useful है। Same zone में failures frequency, ownership, equipment या maintenance problems reveal कर सकती हैं।

Example structure

Area2 — Meets1 — Minor0 — Fails
FixturesClean and functionalSmall correctable soilVisible contamination/major defect
FloorClean and drySmall isolated defectWidespread soil/residue/slip risk
SuppliesAvailableLow but usableRequired item unavailable
OdourNo unresolved sourceMinor source identifiedStrong unresolved source

Practical takeaway

Universal score chase न करें। Local observable rubric बनाएं, users calibrate करें और results से recurring failures identify करें।

संदर्भ

  1. CDC — Environmental Cleaning Procedures.
  2. U.S. GSA — National Custodial Specification.
